usageNotes: Use this to register a new SDN controller (BGP, EVPN, IS-IS, or Faucet) in the cluster-wide SDN configuration. The caller must hold SDN.Allocate on /sdn/controllers. After creating the controller object, you must call PUT /cluster/sdn to apply the pending configuration to all nodes before any networking change takes effect.

examples.summary: Create an EVPN controller with a local AS and two BGP peer addresses

tips: The controller name must match the pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*[a-zA-Z0-9] (2–64 chars) and is immutable after creation — delete and recreate to rename.
After POST, the SDN config is only staged; issue PUT /cluster/sdn (apply) to push changes to node network interfaces.
IS-IS controllers require a correctly formatted isis-net (NSAP address) and at least one interface in isis-ifaces; omitting either causes apply to fail.
For EVPN, the 'peers' field should list the loopback IPs of all other EVPN nodes so FRR can establish BGP EVPN sessions.
The lock-token param is only needed when an earlier SDN operation left the config locked; obtain it from the SDN status before retrying.
